description: Read UTF-8 text content from a workspace-relative file path. Managed operation: call with op:start — it finishes immediately and the result arrives on a later turn as an operation_result envelope whose text carries the bounded file content with pagination info. Supports offset and length.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to read. Required with op:start.

length.description: Optional max bytes to read. Runtime caps this to a safe maximum.
